observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor hall or marquee with tables and chairs around the edge, colorful striped floor mat
observation.dancers: group of mixed men and women
observation.formation_and_space: line formation that changes into pairs and circles, moving around the space
observation.posture: upright torso, knees bent in bouncy action, weight shifting continuously
observation.footwork: lively stepping and hopping on the beat, feet lifting off the floor with alternating steps
observation.arms_and_hands: men holding black hats in one hand; women holding skirt hems and small decorative items or floral arrangements
observation.hips_and_torso: minimal isolated hip movement, torso upright with natural swaying from steps
observation.partnering: pairs dancing facing each other or side by side, some independent movement
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent small hops, individual spinning turns while moving
observation.costume_and_props: men in white shirts, dark vests, trousers, sashes, and black hats; women in bright pink and black skirts, white blouses, shawls, and floral garlands; one dancer balances a box on their head
observation.cannot_infer: low resolution prevents seeing exact foot placements and weight transfer details

signature_moments.what: dancers step and hop vigorously while women flare their skirts outward with both hands
men lift their black hats high with one hand while skipping and turning in place
dancers pair up and spin rapidly in circles while lifting their feet high on each beat
group performs syncopated hopping steps with hats held overhead, moving in a circle
